expectations.text: Uses a diagram or structured layout in plain text (ASCII / indented list / table) of partitions and consumers, with something left for the learner to predict
expectations.evidence:
The plain-text layout lists partitions and consumers and leaves a blank: “Topic 的分区：P0、P1、P2
→ 同一个消费组 G：C1、C2、C3、C4
→ 最多有 ? 个消费者能同时分到分区”.

expectations.text: Asks the learner to predict before showing the complete assignment (e.g. which consumer reads which partition, or what happens with more consumers than partitions)
expectations.evidence: With four consumers and three partitions, it asks “请填出 ?，用一句话说明理由”, requesting a prediction of how many consumers can receive partitions before revealing any assignment.

expectations.text: Does not show the answer in the same message
expectations.evidence: The question remains “最多有 ? 个消费者能同时分到分区”. Across both observed messages, neither the answer nor a completed assignment is provided.

expectations.text: Does not claim to render an interactive or clickable diagram
expectations.evidence: It describes the presentation as “文字关系图”. Neither observed message claims an interactive or clickable diagram.

notes: All four expectations are satisfied by the observed text. No tool calls were observed or needed for these expectations.
